rachel-docs: Heads-up  I opened a small PR to add a 'Retention & Export' micro-guide: sampling guidance, export manifest format, TTL-override workflow, and three tiny SDK snippets (py/ts/curl). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6342

mike-security: Thanks. Please avoid phrasing that sounds like policy promises (no 'we'll keep' or 'indefinitely'). Two security asks: (1) state default retention clearly, (2) call out that exported artifacts are access-controlled and logged.

rachel-docs: Draft sentence: 'Audit logs are retained 90 days by default; exports for legal or contractual obligations may be retained longer.' OK?

mike-security: Slight tweak: 'Customer audit logs are retained for 90 days by default. Exports created to satisfy legal or contractual obligations may be retained longer; exported data is subject to access controls and audit trails.' :+1:

pratyusha-eng: Added three examples for insertion. Python sampling query: ```python
from redwood import AuditClient
c = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = c.query_events(sample=0.01, start='2025-05-01', end='2025-05-31')
print(resp['total'])
```

TypeScript async example: ```ts
import { AuditClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new AuditClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const { total } = await c.queryEvents({ sample: 0.01, start: '2025-05-01', end: '2025-05-31' })
console.log(total)
```

Curl (one-liner): ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sample":0.01,"start":"2025-05-01","end":"2025-05-31"}'
```

jordan-legal: Legal note: use phrase 'as required by law or contractual obligations' and add legal@redwood.com as the legal-hold contact. Also call out that example IDs in docs are pseudonymized.

rachel-docs: Added legal contact + a short pseudonymization example (illustrative only): `{"user_id":"sha256:9b3f...","event":"model.run","ts":"2025-05-15T12:00:00Z"}`

mike-security: Add a short 'sampling bias' callout: samples are fine for rapid triage but can under-represent rare anomalies; recommend full exports before formal investigations. Also include link to the monitoring playbook.

rachel-docs: Done. Also included a tiny export-manifest example and a note on the TTL-override workflow (who to contact and required approval). Will merge after security + legal LGTM. @doc-bot please add 'security-reviewed' label on merge.
